percentileMethod: Fixed pooled raw annual European land-cell histogram order statistics, NumPy linear interpolation; equal cell-year weighting, no area weighting. Annual valid masks may vary.
quantization: Annual fields are aggregated at decoded float64 precision, then rounded to 0.01°C and integer mm. All break arrays and primary ranges use encoded raw values for consistent client classification. Maximum rounding errors are 0.005°C and 0.5mm.

scope.label: Europe
scope.selection: Unsimplified Natural Earth 1:10m country polygons tagged Europe intersected with [-25,34,60,72]; keep grid-cell centers on or inside that intersection. European mainland, Iceland and islands inside bbox included; overseas territories and far-northern islands outside bbox excluded. Russia is included only within bbox; Turkey, Cyprus and the Caucasus countries tagged Asia are excluded. This is a country-continent selection, not a physical Europe/Asia boundary.
scope.mask: Both variables finite in all 12 months AND unsimplified European land at grid-cell center; ocean and non-European land are nodata in both binaries.

smoothing.description: Fill every invalid/ocean/non-European cell with the valid-European raw full-precision field mean separately; Gaussian filter sigma=2 native cells; restore original valid mask; quantize same as raw. Raw percentiles remain unchanged.
smoothing.caveat: Mean filling biases coastal and mask-edge smoothed values toward the European mean. Smoothing is visual only; inspection and statistics use the corresponding year's unsmoothed climate.bin.gz.

globalAttributes.method: These layers from TerraClimate were creating using climatically aided interpolation of monthly anomalies from ERA5 with WorldClim v2.0 climatologies.
globalAttributes.title: TerraClimate: monthly climate and climatic water balance for global land surfaces
globalAttributes.summary: This archive contains a dataset of high-spatial resolution (1/24°, ~4-km) monthly climate and climatic water balance for global terrestrial surfaces from 1950-present. These data were created by using climatically aided interpolation, combining high-spatial resolution climatological normals from the WorldClim version 1.4 and version 2 datasets, with coarser resolution time varying (i.e. monthly) data from ERA5 reanalyses produce a monthly dataset of precipitation, maximum and minimum temperature, wind speed, vapor pressure, and solar radiation. TerraClimate additionally produces monthly surface water balance datasets using a water balance model that incorporates reference evapotranspiration, precipitation, temperature, and interpolated plant extractable soil water capacity. Complementary datasets are also produced for 1950-2025 for counterfactual climate scenarios that remove the first-order influence of climate change, as well as a +2C and +4C scenario that apply a pseudo climate change experiment to observational data. These datasets preserve the observed variability during 1950-2025 but adjust individual climate variables monthly using ensemble median changes derived from CMIP6.
